en: Colorized view of a historic Italian-style town square dominated by a tall medieval stone clock tower with battlements and large circular clock faces on two sides. At the base of the tower is a long, multi‑story palazzo with many rectangular windows and an arched central doorway opening onto a largely empty piazza. A single large tree stands in front of the building, with low arcades visible on the left. The image has a printed, slightly painted look typical of early 20th‑century postcards and shows light grid lines from the printing or artwork process. No visible caption or text appears on the image side.
